subsection.title: Demo Intent
subsection.description: State the core product intent the demo must make visible.

subsection.title: Demo Flow
subsection.description: - Describe the shortest connected demonstration of the approved core ideal use cases. - Use the same Primary Persona. - State the persona's sequential actions and what becomes visible after each action. - Do not replace the journey with a feature or screen tour.

subsection.title: Success Evidence
subsection.description: State what a reviewer or participant must observe to judge the demo successful.

subsection.title: Feedback Questions
subsection.description: Optional. List only the few questions the PoC can directly answer about comprehension, usefulness, or the core intent.
